harness_surface.guardrails: CLAUDE.md (What this agent does not do) + .claude/settings.json deny
harness_surface.skills: skills/<id>@v<n>/ (SKILL.md, skill.json, scripts/, cases.json), run through src/run_skill.py
harness_surface.session_skills: .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md: run-skill, the one that names the runner, with library/index.md and one page per library skill beside it, rendered from the manifests; classify-knowledge; choose-session-level

note: A build copies this tree, fills CLAUDE.md's placeholders, adds tools/<name>/ with adapter.py, tool.json and errors/, fills CAPABILITIES.json and envelope/, writes validation/ and replay/ tasks, copies the skills the specification names into skills/ unchanged, renders .claude/skills/run-skill/library/ from their manifests (index.md and one page per skill) and writes .claude/agents/<name>.md for the subagents it names. The diff from this tree is recorded next to the bundle. v2 added src/run_skill.py and the Subagents section to v1 (meta_agent/tasks/010). v3 adds three session skills (meta_agent/tasks/015; the person, 2026-11-12): run-skill, which sends the bundle's session to src/run_skill.py and says what a session may and may not change, with its library pages; classify-knowledge and choose-session-level, adapted to a bundle from the Meta-Agent's own, naming no path outside the bundle and no script under src/; and in CLAUDE.md the sentences that name them and the rules they repeat. Bundle check B15 judges a bundle of v3 or later. v4 changes text only, after a fresh session was watched in a bundle of v3 (meta_agent/inbox/seats/20261112-meta-macbook-20261112-1-5.json): run-skill also says how a tool that no library skill calls is called, through src/run_tool.py, and its description and CLAUDE.md's sentence for it say so; tasks/001-start.md says that src/validate_tasks.py ends with a failure status when the verdict is undecided and that this is expected; a build with no library skill writes 'no library skill' where it wrote 'no skills'. v5 changes text only, after a fresh session was watched in a copy of a bundle of v4 outside the repository (meta_agent/inbox/seats/20261113-meta-macbook-20261112-1-1.json, answered in meta_agent/inbox/seats/20261113-design-macbook-20261112-1-1.json): tasks/001-start.md covers a scientific verdict of not_run as well as undecided; CLAUDE.md says that envelope/safety.json holds one entry per safety value and that a file with none means no tool requires a gate, that the folder named runs is made by the session when it first writes there, and that an input nothing in the bundle gives is one line in failures.jsonl like a missing skill; run-skill has a section for such an input. v6 changes text and no script, after two fresh sessions worked in copies of bundles of v5 in a test run outside the repository (meta_agent/tasks/016; meta_agent/inbox/seats/20261116-design-macbook-20261116-1-2.json): CLAUDE.md names README.md, TEMPLATE.json and CAPABILITIES.json and says what a claim with not_here is; it says that the runner of skills writes a record only with --record and that the runner of tools writes none, what the status each runner and each check ends with means, that the three checks are not tool calls, that a replay item made by hand is still compared by src/replay.py, and which keys a line of failures.jsonl has; and it says that a grade is the builder's and is not derived here. The bundle carries no grade table: deriving a grade is a calculation, a calculation in a bundle is a library skill, and the library has none for it, so a table without the skill would be read by hand. run-skill repeats the procedure for a record, for a kept output and for a replay item. From this version the builder writes the unit a tool contract names into the Tools section, writes CAPABILITIES.json with the name of the document it read and not its path in the builder's tree, marks a claim that names a tool the bundle does not carry, and lists what is held. Bundle check B16 judges a bundle of this version or later. Every earlier version stays under templates/. v7 changes one script and no text, after a session of a test run built the first agent on an engine (meta_agent/tasks/016; meta_agent/inbox/seats/20261116-design-macbook-20261116-1-8.json): src/validate_tasks.py also judges a scientific task whose reference is what a source states, which the task carries as measure.stated, a map from an output field to the stated value, beside the reference that names the source; nothing is computed, and the agreement is the largest absolute difference, judged against the person's tolerance as before. One tolerance has one unit, so several stated fields are judged together only by an exact tolerance, and otherwise the task is undecided and says to state one field per task. A call that was not made is not_run and not a failure: the gate refused it, a permission was missing, or what the tool needs was not there. A task with a reference function is judged as before. v8 changes the gate and the sentences about it, after the person's word of 2026-11-16 that an engine tool opens by the lab's execution permission (meta_agent/tasks/016; docs/ideas/20261116.md; meta_agent/inbox/seats/20261116-design-macbook-20261116-1-9.json): src/gate.py opens a tool whose contract says safety_gate.opens_by execution_permission, and whose side effects are runs_process or writes_files, where envelope/execution_permission.json is a level a person confirmed that reaches engine or instrument; it refuses such a tool otherwise with a refused_by_safety error that names the level it found, and every other gated tool still opens only by safety values a person wrote. The self-check also says when the permission file is not a person's. CLAUDE.md says what opens each gate and names the file as one a session never writes; run-skill does not name it, since a bundle without such a tool carries no such file (check 24). The builder writes the file from the lab profile a build names, and none where the profile carries the permission only as words. v9 changes the gate, CLAUDE.md and .claude/settings.json, after round three of the clone test built an agent on an engine whose environment no tool of the bundle could make, though the person had allowed pixi from conda-forge (meta_agent/tasks/016; docs/ideas/20261116.md; meta_agent/inbox/seats/20261116-design-macbook-20261116-1-10.json): src/gate.py lets a tool that reaches the network run only as an install, where its contract names installs_from {installer, channel}, its gate opens by the execution permission, the permission reaches engine or instrument and lists that pair under package_sources; it refuses every other network tool with refused_by_safety, code GATE-NETWORK-001, whatever its contract asks of the gate. CLAUDE.md says this is the one network call the agent may make; .claude/settings.json denies a session's edit of envelope/execution_permission.json as it does that of envelope/safety.json. The builder copies package_sources from the lab profile into that file. v10 changes text, the runner of tools and nothing of the gate, after round four's bundle on an engine was tested standing alone (meta_agent/tasks/016; meta_agent/inbox/seats/20261117-design-macbook-20261116-1-1.json): README.md names .claude/agents/ only where a bundle has subagents, and names the permission file and runs/; CLAUDE.md says which file opens which gate and that an empty envelope/safety.json means no tool opens by safety values, that a tool which writes files, and the checks that call it, leave folders under runs/, that the install keeps its package cache in runs/cache, and that a value a run measured is reported with its grade not derived, the grade being derived where the Meta-Agent takes the report into a record; tasks/001-start.md quotes the last line each of the first two checks prints; src/run_tool.py points the package caches of pixi, pip, uv and conda, and the cache root, at runs/cache before the install the gate opens, and refuses an output whose field of unit count is below zero. v11 changes text and the runner of tools and nothing of the gate, after round five's bundle on an engine was tested standing alone (meta_agent/tasks/016; meta_agent/inbox/seats/20261117-design-macbook-20261116-1-4.json). Every path this note names under docs/, meta_agent/ or contracts/ is a record of the builder's repository and is not in this bundle; the reason for each version is said in this note in its own words. CLAUDE.md says that such a path is not looked for and that the builder marks every task and replay item that names one with builder_records, quoting a person's words where it had them; it has a Workflow section the build fills with the order in which the workflow calls the tools, or says that the request gave none; and it says that the install never installs its installer. tasks/001-start.md says that a scientific not_run for want of an engine's environment is followed by the agent's own install and a second run of src/validate_tasks.py. src/run_tool.py looks for the installer a contract names on PATH before the install and, where it is not there, returns an unavailable error that names it and says that putting it there is the person's step. v12 changes text only, on the person's word of 2026-11-17 that a quantity entering a card or a decision is a library skill and a value the engine reports is read (docs/ideas/20261117.md; meta_agent/inbox/seats/20261117-design-macbook-20261116-1-8.json): CLAUDE.md has a Decisions section that says a run-time decision is taken by a diagnostic library skill on a criterion a row hands it, undecided and the person's where the row is null, and that the build fills with each decision the request names: the diagnostic skill, the tool output it judges and the row that hands each criterion; the Procedure says that a value a tool's output reports is read from it and not computed again. v13 changes one script and no text, after the clone of run 20261117-3 built an agent whose scientific tasks measure through a library skill (meta_agent/inbox/seats/20261117-design-macbook-20261116-1-10.json; the intake's analysis, 23bb51b): src/validate_tasks.py runs a scientific task's analysis, handing the call's output field to the skill's input and each other input from its row of envelope/parameters.json, through src/run_skill.py, and judges the skill's named output against the reference; a row that is absent or null leaves the task not_run. v14 changes text only, after the Meep bundle was tested standing alone (meta_agent/tasks/021; meta_agent/failures.jsonl em-7, em-8, em-9) and the Quantum ESPRESSO bundle beside it (dft-5): CLAUDE.md says that the builder also marks a card of its repository named by its id and a question it put to the person named by its number, envelope/parameters.json among the files it marks, quoting the question and any answer; tasks/001-start.md says that before the install an interface task whose call starts the engine fails for want of the environment as a scientific task is not_run, and that the verdict after the install is the one that says whether the interface works. From this version the builder refuses an optional input of a tool contract that names neither a row nor a default, and writes a default into the Tools section.
